plan.title: Vendor formula fields in commercial bid sheet

steps.note: the API built this case's state
Configure the event with an RFQ commercial stage.
Apply the first available RFQ template; the case does not provide a template name.
Create one line item with the requested quantity of 10.
Complete the buyer-side pricing sheet so the RFQ can be published.
Invite a QA vendor for the vendor-portal test.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the live RFQ's commercial bid sheet as the vendor.
Enter the unit price of 100 without submitting, preserving the sheet for immediate formula verification.
Assert that Subtotal displays the calculated value 100 × 10.
Assert that Gross Total Amount displays the expected calculated numeric value.
